name: reaction-bar
summary: The reactions on a message: each an emoji and a count, that a person can press to add theirs or take it back.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Keeps the counts but turns off reacting, for example while offline.

properties.name: moreLabel
properties.description: The add-reaction button's name, for other languages.

properties.name: showMore
properties.description: Shows the add-reaction button after the counts.

slots.name: reactions
slots.description: The reactions, one per line as "key: emoji | name | count | mine" (the word mine is optional and means the person has reacted this way).

events.name: react
events.description: A reaction was pressed; carries its key. The host adds or removes the person's own.

states.name: rest
states.description: One pill per reaction; the person's own is tinted with the accent and pressed.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The pill held down: the accent fill a step stronger.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Counts stay readable; the pills cannot be pressed.

accessibility.name: Each pill is named by its reaction and its count: "Like, 3". The group is named by its label.
accessibility.keyboard: One tab stop per pill; Space or Enter toggles it.
accessibility.web: A role=group of toggle buttons with aria-pressed, each named "Like, 3".
accessibility.apple: Each pill is a button with the selected trait when it is the person's, named "Like, 3".
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Button with the Toggle pattern (On, Off), named "Like, 3", inside a group.
accessibility.android: Each pill is a toggleable node with Role.Checkbox's on or off state and a click action, named "Like, 3", in a labelled container; its 44 dp frame is the hit area.

cases.person: Two pills, 👍 3 tinted as yours and ❤️ 1.
A 👍 2 pill and a plus button after it.
A faded 👍 2 pill that does not respond.

deviations: Web also takes quick reactions, a catalogue, tooltips naming who reacted and a read-only mode; native kits take the counts and the add button, and the host opens its own picker on `more`.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroReactionBar, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroReactionBar, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
